title: A surjective primitive-root trivialization of the coefficient line
statement: For a scheme T, a positive integer N invertible in all local rings, and a commutative ring A annihilated by N, there is a surjective etale morphism q:V→T whose pullback of the finite coefficient Tate line is the tensor unit. The singleton cover gives the corresponding local trivialization.

source.place: Tag 03PK; finite Tate line and tensor powers. Categorical coherence is proved from the existing source integer tensor family and pullback adjunction APIs.

from.place: Construction of the root cover, scalar extension and signed tensor comparisons

proof.text: An additive map between ZMod N modules is automatically linear. The two scalar-extension adjunctions therefore give a natural isomorphism between extending the roots module and extending its underlying abelian sheaf; sheafify it to obtain finiteEtaleLineAbIso.

Invertibility at all stalks implies global invertibility. Pull the primitive-roots algebra cover of the global section ring back along T.toSpecΓ. Its etaleness and surjectivity survive pullback. The universal root has Nth power one and distinct powers with invertible differences.

The existing roots-of-unity constant-sheaf theorem identifies the roots sheaf on V with the constant cyclic sheaf. Pullback commutes with roots and extension of scalars; the scalar extension of the constant cyclic sheaf is the constant A-sheaf. Compose these isomorphisms and package q as a singleton etale cover.

theorem finiteEtaleTateLine_surjectiveTrivialization
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hInvertible : ∀ t : T, IsUnit (N : T.presheaf.stalk t))
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (hA : (N : A) = 0) :
    ∃ (V : Scheme.{u}) (q : V ⟶ T), Etale q ∧ Function.Surjective q.base ∧
      Nonempty ((AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).obj
        (finiteEtaleTateLine T N A hA) ≅
          MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorUnit
            (Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
